name: Social Studies — Community Roles
subject: Social Studies
desc: Community helpers and civic responsibility lesson. Students explore roles in their community, why communities need different helpers, and what it means to belong.

data.lessonTitle: Our Community — Roles, Responsibilities, and Belonging
data.strand: People and Environments — Our Changing Community
data.achKnowledge: Identify at least 4 community helpers and describe their role.
data.achThinking: Explain why communities need people to take on different roles.
data.achCommunication: Describe a community helper's role using complete sentences and key vocabulary.
data.achApplication: Reflect on what role they play or could play in their school community.
data.assessDiagnostic: "Who helps us in our community?" Brainstorm on sticky notes, sort by category on anchor chart.
data.assessFormative: Circulate during activity. Prompts: "What does this person do? Why is their job important?"
data.assessAs: Students share their community helper drawing with a partner using sentence frames.
data.assessOf: Community Helper Portrait: drawing + 2–3 sentence description of role and why it matters.
data.priorLearning: Students have discussed family roles at home. Familiar with concept of a helper from Kindergarten/Grade 1.
data.differentiation:
IEP/ELL: Provide picture cards of community helpers. Sentence frame: "___ helps our community by ___"
Extension: research a community helper not discussed and present to the group.
data.technology: Short video clip of a community helper at work. Smartboard for sorting community roles.
data.mindsOnDesc: Prepare bags with objects from different community helpers (stethoscope, fire hat, library card, ruler). Students guess the helper from the objects. Connect: communities need many different helpers.
data.consolidationDesc: Students share their community helper drawing and read their sentence aloud. Closing: "What role do YOU play in our school community?" Create a class pledge.
data.extension: Interview a family member about their job. Draw or write: How does their work help the community?
